recommendation: #182: recommend Design A (a Phobos-only guard window at vsavj's block entry) to the maintainer

Recommend to the maintainer Design A for #182 (plan182.md): one [[site_thunk]] row in build/manifest/huitzil.toml at vsavj's block entry CPU:$02393A that performs the original +0x140 := 0x12 store and, for fighter id TT = 0x10 only, sets +0x158 := 0x0E and +0x1AB := 0x0E before returning to 0x023940 — vs2's own id-0x10 branch (disasm_gc.txt: vs2 0x022480/0x0224C4). The recommendation rests on Probe A, which is that row added to a copy of huitzil.toml (manifest_diff.txt) and built by a copy of tools/build_merged.sh (builder_diff.txt: the probe manifest path, and an override of the op-count check; 837 ops, build.log). On Probe A: Phobos's two air-block events of tests/replays/chains174/huitzil_c174 match native vs2 on 540/540 frames on the ten traced fields, where merged-m20 matches on 34 and first differs at the block-entry frame (compare.log); tests/audit_chains174.sh turns its two air-block rows from DIFF to IDENT and leaves every other row as frozen (chains174.log); tests/audit_air_gc_legacy.sh passes (air_gc_legacy.log); and tests/audit_merged_legacy.sh, run through a probe copy whose only change is the same op-count override (oracle_diff.txt) with MERGED_PREBUILT=1 and MERGED_EXPECT=tests/expected/merged-m20, passes 53/53 legacy pairings with every per-replay line identical to the same invocation on the shipped merged-m20 build (merged_legacy_probeA.log, merged_legacy_m20base.log), while the thunk ran on legacy content 171 times over 8 of those 53 replays (blockcount/out/summary.txt). Design B, a patch in Phobos's own ported check at 0x414920, is not recommended: the window is written at block entry, and the only state his check could key on is the air-block state, which on ours runs 37 and 27 frames to landing against native's 11- and 10-frame window (airblock_lengths.log). NOT tested: the cycle cost (estimated at about 50 cycles per block entry from instruction timings, not measured); FBNeo and the MiSTer lane on Probe A; the solo Phobos track built with the row; Phobos as P2; any air block other than these two events; the static tier and the freeze battery on the probe; how the rule-5 census classifies the row; and the vs2 Dark Force air-guard-cancel glitch the maintainer quoted from Mizuumi, which the plan asks to measure before building.
